intensity_definition: Sum of FPMA and FPMB background-subtracted aperture rates, each divided by its own integrated HK livetime. Default band is the union of the soft and hard windows.
limitations: Aperture count rates, not unfolded photon or energy flux.
No PSF/aperture-loss, vignetting, bad-pixel/exposure-map or response correction.
Background uses a circular aperture with geometric area scaling; source wings and detector nonuniformity can bias it.
Statistical errors use Poisson propagation; detector dead-time correlations and calibration systematics are not included.
Times are spacecraft TT (not barycenter corrected). Archive-calibrated mode-01 events are used without reprocessing.
